ev.q: Two domestic cats with respiratory illnesses lasting 8 and 10 days are the first reported companion animals
Both cats had SARS-CoV-2–specific virus neutralizing antibodies
Results of SARS-CoV-2 real-time RT-PCR, partial next-generation sequencing, SARS-CoV-2 virus neutralization
determined that results for both cat A and B were positive at the first specimen collections
Notification of presumptive positive animal test results triggered a One Health investigation by state and federal partners

methods_quotes.q: Real-time RT-PCR, using a modified CDC N-target assay and sequencing
